requirements: An adopted outline version must not claim more strongly frozen chapters than it selects.
Malformed or rehashed persisted outline versions must fail closed before execution readiness can consume them.
implementationRefs: api/src/outlineCommit.spec.ts:fails closed when a persisted outline version freezes more chapters than it selects

tests.red: A rehashed persisted version with strongFreezeCount greater than selectedChapterIds.length was accepted.
tests.green: outlineCommit.spec.ts passed 6/6 after enforcing strongFreezeCount <= selectedChapterIds.length.

notYetProven: This validates one RP4 persistence invariant, not the full outline-to-prose journey.
Execution-ready proof still requires representative chapter execution and fresh context evidence.
Full release migration, external calibration, independent review, and delivery proof remain incomplete.
